findings.title: Billed ICU days exceed documented stay in ICU
findings.detail: The final in-patient bill charges for 3 days of ICU accommodation, but the discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission (1 day in ICU).

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy invoice dated prior to prescription
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice from WellMed Pharmacy is dated 18 Oct 2024, which precedes the hospital discharge prescription dated 19 Oct 2024.
